parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action specified in the rule. Valid values:

*   **1**: alert
*   **2**: block

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the rule.

>  You can call the [ListContainerDefenseRule](~~2590599~~) operation to query the IDs of rules.

parameters.name: RuleSwitch
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

*   **1**: enabled
*   **0**: disabled

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

*   1: system rule
*   2: custom rule

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The effective scope of the rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-container-defense-rule --rule-id 123 --rule-action 1 --rule-switch 1 --rule-name text-001 --description '防御规则。' --rule-type 1 --whitelist '{"Path":["/home/workspace/"],"Hash":["0"],"Image":["repo:tag"]}' --scope '[{"Namespaces":["kube-system"],"ClusterId":"c54b0001501","AllNamespace":1}]' --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
